info.name: Egoola-BuyerApp
info.description: Everything built for buyers (web and app): sign-up and login, the public location lists, category browse, products, gigs and the seller page. Most of it needs no login. Docs: docs/buyer-api-guide.md and docs/public-api-guide.md. Import it with Egoola-Local.postman_environment.json.

item.name: Buyer sign-up and login
item.description: Only name, mobile and password are required. See docs/buyer-api-guide.md.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 201) { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.test('logged in', () => { pm.expect(b.access).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(b.status).to.eql('active'); }); }
if (pm.response.code < 300) { const b = pm.response.json(); if (b.access) pm.collectionVariables.set('buyer_token', b.access); }

request.description: The three required fields. The response already carries the tokens. The mobile number is generated once per run.
`buyer with this phone already exists.`
`name`, `phone` and `password` are required.
`Enter a valid mobile number (digits only, may start with +).`
All optional. Locations need ids that exist (126 / 13 / 8 on the local data). A profile picture needs multipart: add a `profile_pic` file in the Postman app.

Public, read-only, no token. Fills the country dropdown on the sign-up form. Rows: id, name, slug, country_code, flag_url.

exec: pm.test("has countries", () => { const r = pm.response.json().results; pm.expect(r.length).to.be.at.least(1); pm.expect(r[0]).to.have.all.keys('id','name','slug','country_code','flag_url'); });

request.description: Call again whenever the country changes. Rows: id, name, slug, country.

exec: pm.test("every state belongs to the country", () => { pm.response.json().results.forEach(r => pm.expect(String(r.country)).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('country_id'))); });

request.description: Filters: `country`, `state`. Rows: id, name, slug, country, state.

exec: pm.test("every city belongs to the state", () => { pm.response.json().results.forEach(r => pm.expect(String(r.state)).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('lookup_state_id'))); });

item.name: Thanas of the chosen city (dropdown 4, optional)

request.description: Filters: `country`, `state`, `city`. The thana is optional on the sign-up form, so an empty list is normal.
`search` matches part of the name. Every list also takes `limit` (default 500, max 1000) and `offset`.

item.name: A stale token does not break a public read

request.description: Public routes ignore the Authorization header, so an expired token in the browser can never cause a 401 here.
Creating, editing and deleting geography stays on the admin API (`/api/v1/geography/`).

item.name: Categories
item.description: The one category list of the Buyer Panel. No login. Page-based paging: page, page_size.

request.description: No login. No filter = the active categories that have no parent. Page-based paging: `page` (from 1) and `page_size` (default 20, max 100).

exec: pm.test('shape + only roots', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b).to.have.keys('count','page','page_size','total_pages','results'); b.results.forEach(c => pm.expect(c.parent).to.eql(null)); }); const first = pm.response.json().results[0]; if (first) pm.collectionVariables.set('browse_parent_id', first.id);

request.description: Call the same API with a category id as `parent_id` to get its active children. Repeat for each level. `has_children` tells whether to go deeper. `404` if the parent does not exist or is inactive.
Partial, case-insensitive, on `name` or `name_bn`. Without `parent_id` it searches every level.
With `parent_id` the search is limited to that parent's direct children.
`type=product` or `service`.
Response has `page`, `page_size`, `total_pages`.
`page_size` must be 1–100.
`{"parent_id": ["A valid integer is required."]}`
`{"detail": "Category not found."}`

request.description: Approved listings of verified, active sellers with an active SKU. Page-based: `page`, `page_size`. Response `{count, page, page_size, total_pages, results}`.

exec: const r = pm.response.json().results; if (r && r[0]) pm.collectionVariables.set('product_id', r[0].id); if (r && r[0] && r[0].seller) pm.collectionVariables.set('seller_id', r[0].seller.id);

item.name: Cart
item.description: A buyer's own cart: one active cart per type (product/service), picked automatically by the added listing's own type. Needs a buyer token — run 'Buyer sign-up and login' first, or set {{buyer_token}} manually. Needs {{product_id}}/{{product_sku_id}} and {{gig_id}}/{{gig_sku_id}} set (see Products/Gigs folders). See docs/buyer-api-guide.md section 3.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 201) { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set('cart_item_id', b.id); pm.test('qty saved', () => pm.expect(b.qty).to.eql(2)); }
